# Kidora

> Turn screen time into meaningful growth. Kidora creates personalised audio stories, moral adventures, and educational games tailored to your child.

Kidora is an educational kids content platform dedicated to replacing mindless video scrolling with active, values-based discovery. Designed in consultation with child development and literacy specialists, Kidora tailors custom audio songs, personalized bedtime stories, and educational browser games based on a child's name, age bracket (2-4, 4-6, 6-8, 8-10 years), primary curiosity interests (Space, Dinosaurs, Animals, Ocean, Superheroes, Science), and family values (Kindness, Courage, Honesty, Sharing, Curiosity).

Content packs are hand-crafted and delivered directly to parents via WhatsApp within 24 hours in high-fidelity MP3 and printable PDF storybook formats.

## Key Features & Explorations

- [Personalisation Creator Studio](https://www.kidora.fun/#personalise): An interactive configuration studio enabling parents to customize child avatars, companion pets, and life-lesson narratives with real-time audio previews.
- [Educational Games Playroom](https://www.kidora.fun/#games): Kid-safe in-browser educational mini-games including FactBlast AI trivia, phonics spelling labs, space mathematics, and logical memory challenges.
- [Screen Time Impact Calculator](https://www.kidora.fun/#calculator): Interactive diagnostic tool comparing passive video autoplay habits against interactive storytelling (+240 vocabulary words/mo vs passive consumption).
- [Bedtime Mode & Calming Synthesizer](https://www.kidora.fun/): Gentle chimes, guided relaxation soundscapes, and sleep timers to ease kids into restful bedtime routines.
- [Packs & Transparent Pricing](https://www.kidora.fun/#products): One-time packs starting at ₹299 (Magic Jingle), ₹499 (Growth Duo Pack), and ₹899 (Birthday Mega Pack) with no subscriptions and free revisions.

## Safety & Educational Standards

- 100% Ad-Free, safe, and vetted for positive developmental outcomes.
- Zero algorithmic dark patterns or autoplay feedback loops.
- Active moral decision-making embedded in every narrative.
- Direct delivery to parent devices with no child accounts required.
